prompt: Tell me the name of the place I am thinking of based on these clues:  - I am a metropolitan borough in the West Midlands, UK - I am not a city - My boroughs name does not relate to a town
answer:
The place is **Sandwell**.

It is one of the seven metropolitan boroughs of the West Midlands. Unlike Birmingham, Coventry and Wolverhampton, it is not a city, and unlike Dudley, Solihull and Walsall, **“Sandwell” is not the name of a town**—it refers historically to Sandwell Priory and the surrounding area.
